__1 A sack. गोणीं जनेन स्म निधातुमुधृतामनुक्षणं नोक्षतरः प्रतीच्छति [[Śi. 12. 10.]] 
__2 A measure of capacity equal to a Droṇa. 
__3 Ragged garment, torn clothes.

__1 A fleshy navel. 
__2 A person with a fleshy navel. 
__3 A man of a low tribe, a mountaineer, especially one inhabiting the eastern portion of the Vindhya range between the Narmadā and Kṛṣṇā. 
-Comp. 
-किरी N. of a Rāgiṇi. 
-वनम् N. of a country in Berar.
